summary:
Implemented a Quick Sheet fuse workflow.

Changed `quick-sheet.html`, `quick-sheet.js`, and `styles.css` to add a compact Fuse Check Note under Fuse Triage with symptom chips, owner detail field, live preview, Copy/Share/Save Garage Note, and Hood/Cabin fuse routes. Updated search metadata, cache version `ridgeline-console-v368`, smoke coverage, `AGENT_STATE.md`, `SITE_QUALITY_AUDIT.md`, and `agent-last-run.json`.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('quick-sheet.html') -Tag audit-v368-fuse-check-note -SkipScreenshots`
- Final Home smoke: `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the Fuse Check Note with an actual fuse-cover label/photo, or rotate to Garage/Maintenance visibility or shared iPhone header/Dynamic Island review.

Impact Score: 4/5  
Visible Change: Quick Sheet now has a Fuse Check Note for capturing and saving fuse-label context before pulling a fuse.  
Impact Reason: It gives the iPhone owner a fast, practical handoff for fuse symptoms without changing fuse facts or Garage schema.
